changelog.body:
First public release.

- Brief mode: a ColorOS-style banner with a One UI animation for each new notification.
- Detailed mode: notification cards on the AOD, up to four at a time.
- Position, banner duration, colored or monochrome icons.
- Latest notification on tap, when power saving has hidden the AOD clock.
- Pocket check, and respect for the lock screen content setting and private apps.
- Settings screen made of the real ColorOS components, and a Notifications row in the system AOD settings.
- The interface follows the system language (67 languages).

Scope: System UI and Always-On Display. Restart System UI after installing.

---

首个公开版本。

- 简洁模式：新通知以 ColorOS 风格的横幅显示，带有 One UI 式动画。
- 详细模式：通知卡片常驻息屏，最多同时显示四张。
- 可设置位置、横幅显示时长，图标可保留原色或使用单色。
- 省电模式隐藏息屏时钟后，轻触屏幕可显示最新通知。
- 口袋检测，并遵循锁屏隐藏通知内容设置和隐私应用。
- 设置界面使用 ColorOS 原生组件，并在系统息屏设置中添加“通知”入口。
- 界面语言跟随系统（67 种语言）。

作用域：系统界面 和 息屏。安装后请重启系统界面。

readme: # AOD Notify Brief and detailed notifications on the Always-On Display of ColorOS 17, in the style of One UI. ## Features - **Brief**: a ColorOS-style banner with a One UI animation shows each new notification for a few seconds. - **Detailed**: notification cards stay on the AOD, up to four at a time. - Position, banner duration, colored or monochrome icons. - **Latest notification on tap**: when power saving has hidden the AOD clock and you tap the screen, the latest notification shows with the clock. - Nothing is shown while the phone is in a pocket. - Respects the system setting that hides lock screen content, and private apps. - Settings screen made of the real ColorOS components, and a **Notifications** row in Settings → Home screen, Lock screen & style → Always-On Display → Display settings. - The interface follows the system language (67 languages). ## Requirements - ColorOS 17. Tested on a OnePlus 15T (China ROM), AOD app 17.001.0021. - LSPosed 2.x with libxposed API 101 or newer. ## Setup 1. Install the APK and enable the module in LSPosed. 2. Scope: **System UI** and **Always-On Display** (`com.oplus.aod`). The second is only needed for the row in system settings; the module asks for it on first launch. 3. Restart System UI (or reboot) after installing or updating. 4. Open AOD Notify and pick a mode. To undo everything, disable the module and restart System UI. ## Source code https://github.com/Makish003/AodNotify (GPL-3.0) --- # AOD Notify（中文） 在 ColorOS 17 的息屏显示上以简洁或详细样式显示通知，效果类似 One UI。 ## 功能 - **简洁**：新通知以 ColorOS 风格的横幅显示几秒，带有 One UI 式动画。 - **详细**：通知卡片常驻息屏，最多同时显示四张。 - 可设置位置、横幅显示时长，图标可保留原色或使用单色。 - **轻触显示最新通知**：省电模式隐藏息屏时钟后轻触屏幕，最新一条通知会随时钟一起显示。 - 手机放在口袋中时不显示任何内容。 - 遵循系统的锁屏隐藏通知内容设置和隐私应用。 - 设置界面使用 ColorOS 原生组件，并在 设置 → 桌面、锁屏与个性化 → 息屏显示 → 显示设置 中添加 **通知** 入口。 - 界面语言跟随系统（67 种语言）。 ## 要求 - ColorOS 17。已在一加 15T（国行版）、息屏应用 17.001.0021 上测试。 - LSPosed 2.x，libxposed API 101 或更高版本。 ## 使用方法 1. 安装 APK，并在 LSPosed 中启用模块。 2. 作用域：**系统界面** 和 **息屏**（`com.oplus.aod`）。后者仅用于系统设置中的入口，模块首次启动时会自动请求。 3. 安装或更新后重启系统界面（或重启手机）。 4. 打开 AOD Notify 并选择模式。 如需恢复原状，在 LSPosed 中停用模块并重启系统界面即可。 ## 源代码 https://github.com/Makish003/AodNotify（GPL-3.0）
